name: verify-local-web-preview
job: Verify local web or game preview: load, screenshot, console gate, with fail-closed page-error checks.

inScope: Locating the actual listen URL or port
Capturing a screenshot via host tools or Playwright smoke
Inspecting layout, blank canvas, and obvious defects
Recording URL, status, screenshot, console errors, and untested items
outOfScope: Claiming production readiness from smoke alone
Sending agent-only localhost chores to a human

outputs: Console and page-error list or clean gate, plus human-facing summary
failureSemantics: Console or page errors fail the gate; a 200 alone is not visual proof; movement games need control-sign self-tests, not screenshots only; missing tools are reported as a gap, never faked.

outcome.observable: A recorded preview load with screenshot or explicit tool-gap, a fail-closed console gate result, and a human-facing summary that makes no false production claims.
